about: The coding agents this kit can register its MCP server with, as rows of data. A new agent costs a row. Read by builder/lib/agents.mjs; checked by tests/agents.test.mjs. A row's `plugin` (or null) is the agent's own commands for installing this kit's plugin, which carries the studio bridge's hooks; an agent with no such command gets null and the studio page cannot reach its session yet. Placeholders in an argument list: {name} the server's name, {scope} the chosen scope, {command} the program that starts the server (an absolute path to this Node), and {...args} (a whole element) which expands to the server's arguments. We never edit an agent's own configuration file: registration is the agent's own command, and reading is the agent's own list or get command. Nothing here reads, copies or stores a credential, a login or a token.

files.note: The user-level file is kept by `claude mcp`; this kit never reads or writes it.

mcp.restartHint: nothing to type: this session hears the studio page through node bin/gamesfun.mjs session wait (run it in the background), and new sessions load the tools and the plugin by themselves (/reload-plugins loads them into this one, if you want).

plugin.about: The kit's plugin (plugin/: the studio bridge's hooks and the play-tester subagent), installed from this checkout through Claude Code's own plugin commands. The checkout is a marketplace of one plugin (.claude-plugin/marketplace.json). {kit} is this checkout's folder. listMarketplaces says which folder the marketplace was added from, so connect can tell one added from another checkout.
plugin.name: gamesfun

files.note: Codex keeps its servers in the user-level file; this kit adds one only through `codex mcp add`.

mcp.restartHint: Start a new Codex session so it picks up the new server.
